title: Roof Replacement in Canby, OR
summary: In September 2026, French Roofing replaced a shingle roof in Canby, OR. The crew tore off the old gray shingles and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, finished with ridge cap along the ridge. The result is a clean, even gray roof from the eaves up to the ridge.
scope: Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
Capped the ridge with new ridge cap shingles
body: The before and after below were taken from the same spot on the roof. In the first, tear-off is just starting along the bottom edge of the old shingles. In the second, the same roof plane is finished in new Landmark shingles.

faqs.question: Were the old shingles removed on this Canby job?
faqs.answer: Yes. The crew tore off the old shingles before the new roof went on, so the new shingles aren't laid over an old layer.

faqs.question: What shingles were installed?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles in gray, with ridge cap shingles along the ridge.
